purpose: Bounded exact-location catalog metadata acquisition. No redistribution license is inferred.

sources.basis: Direct FetchUrl checks allow public property paths and prohibit disruptive scraping. Requests are sequential per host. Internal /api/, account, guidance, claim, report-action and inquiry paths are not used.
sources.rights: Source terms do not grant Harbor a review-text redistribution license. New acquisition retains only original review links, native IDs, dates and exclusions. Previously approved short excerpts and independently approved editorial paraphrases keep their distinct representations.
